company.name: SuperMama
company.shortDescription: SuperMama is an online Arabian female and family portal that provides information about pregnancy and parenting for mothers.
company.description:
SuperMama operates female and family portals in the Arab World. SuperMama is a fast-growing start-up founded by Yasmine El-Mehairy & Zeinab Samir.

The Website is a modern up-to-date platform that provides mothers with information not only about pregnancy and parenting, but rather all the aspects of a mother’s life including home management, food and career and even her relationship with her husband. SuperMama offers trusted information verified by experts in different including nutritionists, doctors and psychologists. SuperMama also offers a space for discussions and sharing experience and knowledge between mothers.
